purpose: Functional and acceptance test cases derived from the SATYA master development requirements, including its testing requirements.
scope_note: These are test definitions, not claimed execution results. Run them against the current SATYA project. Synthetic demo evidence must remain clearly labelled and unmatched claims must remain UNVERIFIED.

test_cases.title: Application loads
steps: Open the SATYA application in a supported browser.
expected: Both WhatsApp and SATYA phone frames render.
No fatal runtime error prevents interaction.

test_cases.title: Select a sample forwarded message
steps: Open the WhatsApp simulation.
Select each available sample message.
expected: The selected sample appears in the simulated conversation.
The selected sample is the one offered for copying.

test_cases.title: Copy and paste message into SATYA
steps: Select a sample forward.
Copy it.
Paste it into SATYA.
expected: The pasted text matches the selected message exactly.
The message is transferred only through a user-initiated action.

test_cases.title: Reject empty input gracefully
steps: Leave the message input empty.
Click Verify.
expected: No fabricated claim or verdict is generated.
A clear validation message is shown.
The application remains usable.

test_cases.title: Detect English input
steps: Submit a clear English message.
test_cases.input: The government has announced a new public service scheme.
expected: Detected language is English (en).

test_cases.title: Detect Hindi input
steps: Submit a clear Hindi message written in Devanagari.
test_cases.input: सरकार ने सभी विद्यार्थियों के लिए नई योजना शुरू की है।
expected: Detected language is Hindi (hi), subject to the documented detector's supported cases.

test_cases.title: Detect Marathi input
steps: Submit a clear Marathi message written in Devanagari.
test_cases.input: सरकारने विद्यार्थ्यांसाठी नवीन योजना सुरू केली आहे.
expected: Detected language is Marathi (mr), subject to the documented detector's supported cases.

test_cases.title: Extract multiple factual claims separately
steps: Submit a message containing at least two distinct factual statements.
Inspect the report.
test_cases.input: The scheme started in 2020. Every student is eligible.
expected: Distinct factual statements are represented as separate claims where the extraction logic supports sentence splitting.
Each extracted claim receives its own assessment.

test_cases.title: Support all five verdict values
steps: Exercise evidence fixtures representing each supported outcome.
expected: The engine and report support exactly the five listed primary statuses.
Each status has a readable text label and distinguishable visual treatment.

test_cases.title: Unmatched claim remains unverified
steps: Submit a novel claim that does not match any evidence record.
test_cases.input: A newly invented local claim with no matching evidence record.
expected: Claim verdict is UNVERIFIED.
The application does not infer FALSE solely because no match exists.
The explanation states the limits of available evidence.

test_cases.title: Display evidence provenance
steps: Submit a claim matching a populated evidence record.
Inspect its report card.
test_cases.input: A deterministic claim matching a configured evidence fixture
expected: Available source title, issuing organisation, publication date, excerpt and URL are displayed.
Missing metadata is not invented.
Synthetic fixtures are labelled as demonstrations.

test_cases.title: Generate an overall assessment from claim results
steps: Submit a message with multiple claims and inspect the overall verdict.
test_cases.input: A message containing claims with different evidence outcomes
expected: An overall assessment is generated from claim-level results.
The report does not hide materially different claim outcomes.

test_cases.title: Change report or spoken output language
steps: Verify a message.
Change output language among English, Hindi and Marathi.
expected: The selected language changes the explanation or speech output where translation is implemented.
Changing output language does not change the underlying verification verdict.
Unavailable translations or voices are disclosed rather than silently substituted.

test_cases.title: Speech controls behave correctly
steps: Verify a message.
Test Play, Pause, Resume, Replay and Stop.
expected: Controls invoke the corresponding SpeechSynthesis actions when supported.
If the requested language voice is unavailable, the app informs the user and preserves the written report.

test_cases.title: Verify a second message without reloading
steps: Verify one message.
Clear or replace the input.
Verify another message.
expected: The second report reflects the second message.
Stale claims or evidence from the first report are not retained.

test_cases.title: Reset demo resets both frames
steps: Change the WhatsApp sample.
Enter text and generate a report in SATYA.
Click Reset demo.
test_cases.input: Modified WhatsApp sample and populated SATYA report
expected: WhatsApp returns to its default sample.
SATYA input and report are cleared.
Relevant selectors and status state return to their defaults.

test_cases.title: Layout works on narrow screens
steps: Open the app at a narrow mobile viewport.
Scroll and interact with both frames.
expected: Phone frames stack without horizontal overflow.
Inputs, buttons and reports remain readable and usable.

test_cases.title: No WhatsApp account access or background collection
steps: Inspect network requests and browser permissions during ordinary local demo use.
expected: The web prototype does not connect to WhatsApp or read private WhatsApp messages.
No message is transmitted to a third party by default.
The user deliberately initiates message submission.

test_cases.title: Spoken summaries are concise and verdict-safe
steps: Generate spoken summaries for all five verdicts in English, Hindi and Marathi.
Inspect the synthetic FALSE summary.
expected: Each summary is concise, localized, and does not read claim text or report metadata.
Synthetic FALSE is explicitly described as a demonstration and not a real-world fact-check.
UNVERIFIED explicitly does not mean false.

test_cases.title: Speech voice selection matches the report language
steps: Select voices for English, Hindi and Marathi from a mixed-language voice list.
Try selecting Hindi or Marathi when the matching voice is absent.
test_cases.input: A mixed-language set of browser voice descriptors
expected: Only voices matching the requested language are selected.
Natural-sounding matching voices are preferred.
No voice is selected when the requested language is unavailable.

test_cases.title: Speech settings and transcript preview are applied
steps: Inspect the configured utterance settings.
Open a report and compare the visible preview with the spoken text.
expected: Pitch is within 1.08–1.15, rate within 0.92–0.98, and volume is 1.0.
The report passes the short generated summary to audio controls.
The same exact summary is visible before playback.

test_cases.title: VoiceAPI request maps all language and gender choices
steps: Send mock VoiceAPI synthesis requests for English, Hindi and Marathi male and female voices.
Inspect each request voice key, speed, pitch and response audio format.
expected: Voice IDs are en_male, en_female, hi_male, hi_female, mr_male and mr_female.
The React frontend sends the short summary and selected speed and pitch to POST /synthesize.
The client accepts WAV audio and includes no backend credentials.

test_cases.title: Voice selection, synthesis controls and browser fallback are available
steps: Inspect language and male/female selectors, speed and pitch controls.
Stop existing playback when changing reports or settings.
Verify browser speech fallback when VoiceAPI is unavailable.
test_cases.input: A generated report and unavailable VoiceAPI
expected: Play, Pause, Resume, Replay and Stop are retained.
VoiceAPI loading and error states are shown.
A matching-language browser voice is used as fallback when available; unavailable voice errors are shown otherwise.
Only one voice or audio stream plays at a time.

test_cases.title: Listen to each neural voice with the real VoiceAPI backend
steps: Start VoiceAPI with the required model weights downloaded.
Generate and listen to each of the six language and gender combinations.
Confirm voice identity, language pronunciation, output quality and controls.
expected: Each selected neural voice returns playable audio in the selected language and gender.
Speed and pitch controls affect the generated audio.
Audio is intelligible, natural and suitable for the short report summary.

execution_summary.note: Execution statuses are intentionally NOT_RUN until the JSON suite is run against the current source project in its working environment.
